expectations.evidence: Filter trait with apply(&self, image: &mut Image) and name(&self) -> &str. All 5 filters implement it. Trait returns void instead of Result though.
Each filter owns its parameters as struct fields. Identical approach to with-skill version.
Pipeline with Vec<Box<dyn Filter>> and .add(impl Filter + 'static) -> Self. Nice ergonomic touch: add() takes impl Filter rather than Box, doing the boxing internally.

Explanation mentions Command pattern and Builder pattern, plus Open/Closed Principle. Identifies the patterns but with less precision — calls it 'Command pattern via a Filter trait' rather than Strategy, which is more accurate for this use case.
